hindi: षाड्गुण्य की योनि प्रकृति-मण्डल है।
english: The circle of constituent elements is the source of the sixfold policy.
notes: yoni literally 'womb'; rendered 'source'. prakṛti-maṇḍala could also be read as the circle of the king's constituent elements (the seven prakṛtis) in the sense of the circle of states; kept literal.

words.gloss: peace, war, staying quiet, march, seeking refuge, the dual policy

hindi: “सन्धि, विग्रह, आसन, यान, संश्रय और द्वैधीभाव षाड्गुण्य हैं,” ऐसा आचार्य कहते हैं।
english: “Peace, war, staying quiet, march, seeking refuge and the dual policy are the sixfold policy,” say the teachers.
notes: vigraha = war (hostility); yāna = march; saṃśraya = seeking refuge (taking shelter). The six are listed as one dvandva. Printed sandhi.vigraha... is one compound with the six members; dvaidhī-bhāva is itself a compound (the dual policy).

hindi: “द्वैगुण्य,” ऐसा वातव्याधि कहते हैं।
english: “The twofold policy,” says Vatavyadhi.
notes: Name of a teacher (glossary: Vatavyadhi). dvaiguṇya modelled on ṣāḍguṇya = the twofold policy (literally 'doubleness of guṇas'). Unit 3 and 4 form one quoted view.

hindi: “क्योंकि सन्धि और विग्रह से षाड्गुण्य सिद्ध होता है।”
english: “For the sixfold policy is accomplished by peace and war,” [says he].
notes: The speaker is the same Vatavyadhi of unit 3; 'says he' is supplied in brackets in English only, as the Sanskrit has only the closing iti. sampadyate = comes about / is accomplished.

hindi: “यह षाड्गुण्य ही है, अवस्था के भेद से,” ऐसा कौटिल्य कहते हैं।
english: “This is indeed the sixfold policy, by difference of state,” says Kautilya.
notes: avasthā-bheda: 'states' (conditions) of the king; avasthā number not marked in the compound, singular/plural both possible.

hindi: उनमें पण-बन्ध सन्धि है।
english: Among these, the pledge-binding is peace.
notes: paṇa here: pledge, stipulation, agreement (not the coin); alternative 'binding by conditions'. Literal rendering kept; paṇa-bandha is a technical term for a treaty. tatra 'among these' (locative sense).

hindi: अपकार विग्रह है।
english: Injury is war.
notes: apakāra = doing harm, injury, hostile act; vigraha = war (hostility).

hindi: उपेक्षा आसन है।
english: Indifference is staying quiet.
notes: upekṣaṇa = disregard, neglect; rendered 'indifference'.

hindi: संचय यान है।
english: Heaping up is march.
notes: abhyuccaya = piling up, accumulation, rising; the sense (building up of strength) is not stated; kept literal. Alternative 'increase'.

hindi: दूसरे को सौंप देना संश्रय है।
english: Giving over to another is seeking refuge.
notes: The object given over is not stated (oneself understood by tradition); not supplied. para = another/the other (king).

words.gloss: taking up of peace and war

hindi: सन्धि और विग्रह को ग्रहण करना द्वैधीभाव है।
english: The taking up of peace and war is the dual policy.
notes: sandhi-vigraha is a dvandva inside the compound.

hindi: ये छह गुण हैं।
english: Such [are] the six guṇas.
notes: guṇa kept as a term (here a policy). Closing summary iti handled per glossary (3.7): 'Such [are] X'.

hindi: दूसरे से हीन होता हुआ सन्धि करे।
english: [One] being diminished by the other should make peace.

text_flags.why: possible: the dh of hīyamānaḥ appears split from the preceding d by a space (sandhi t+h gives d dh)

notes: hīyamāna from √hā 'to fall short, decline'; literal 'being diminished'. The subject is the participle itself (one so placed). para = the other (king).

hindi: संचित होता हुआ विग्रह करे।
english: [One] being heaped up should wage war.
notes: abhyuccīyamāna: literal 'being heaped up' (built up); the sense 'growing in strength' is not stated; alternative 'being augmented'. Same root as abhyuccaya in unit 9.

hindi: “न दूसरा मुझे हानि पहुँचाने में समर्थ है, न मैं दूसरे को हानि पहुँचाने में,” — आसन में रहे।
english: “The other is not able to injure me, nor am I able to injure the other,” [one] should stay quiet.
notes: Quoted thought followed by iti; the iti is carried by the quotation marks. āsīta (√ās 'sit') = stay quiet, as in āsana. The subject of āsīta is not expressed.

hindi: गुणों की अधिकता से युक्त चढ़ाई करे।
english: [One] endowed with an excess of qualities should march.
notes: guṇa here: qualities/advantages (not the six guṇas of unit 12); atiśaya = excess. yāyāt = should march (glossary 9.1).

hindi: शक्ति से हीन आश्रय ले।
english: [One] lacking power should seek refuge.
notes: śakti = power (glossary 6.2).

hindi: सहायक से साध्य कार्य में द्वैधीभाव अपनाए।
english: In a task to be accomplished with help, [one] should resort to the dual policy.
notes: gacchet = literally 'should go to'; rendered 'resort to'. sahāya may be helper/ally; kept 'help'.

hindi: यह गुणों की अवस्थापना है।
english: Such is the establishing of the guṇas.
notes: avasthāpana = placing, setting up, fixing. Closing label per glossary.

words.gloss: works of forts, embankments, trade routes, settlements of empty land, mines, produce, elephants, forests

hindi: उनमें अथवा जिस गुण में स्थित देखे, “यहाँ स्थित रहकर मैं अपने दुर्ग-सेतु-कर्म, वणिक्-पथ, शून्य-निवेश, खान, द्रव्य-वन और हस्ति-वन के कर्मों को चलाने में और दूसरे के इन कर्मों को हानि पहुँचाने में समर्थ होऊँगा,” उसका आश्रय ले।
english: Of these, or in whichever guṇa [one] stands, [one] should see: “Standing here, I shall be able to set in motion my own works — the work of forts and embankments, trade routes, settlements on empty land, mines, produce forests and elephant forests — and to injure these works of the other,” [and] should adopt that [guṇa].
notes: The printed compound contains karma twice: the first read within durga-setu-karma, the final karmāṇi as the head noun over the rest; dravya-hasti-vana read as 'produce-forest and elephant-forest'. Rendering of the members is literal (vaṇik-patha = merchants' road, śūnya-niveśa = settlement [of] empty [land]); the exact sense of each member is not settled. 'vā' after yasmin rendered 'or'. tam refers to that guṇa.

hindi: वह वृद्धि है।
english: That is growth.
notes: vṛddhi = growth (glossary 9.7).

hindi: “मेरी वृद्धि अधिक शीघ्र, अधिक बड़ी अथवा वृद्धि-उदय में अधिक होगी, दूसरे की विपरीत,” जानकर दूसरे की वृद्धि की उपेक्षा करे।
english: “My growth will be quicker, greater or of greater yield of growth; the other's, the reverse,” knowing [this], [one] should disregard the other's growth.
notes: vṛddhy-udayatarā is obscure (udaya = rise, yield, outcome); read literally as 'of greater yield of growth'; alternative 'with greater rise of growth'. 'this' in brackets supplied in English only.

words.gloss: having equal time, fruit and rise

hindi: अथवा समान काल, फल और उदय वाली वृद्धि में सन्धि अपनाए।
english: Or, in a growth having equal time, fruit and rise, [one] should resort to peace.
notes: udaya = rise/yield; phala = fruit/result; the exact relation of the three is not stated.

hindi: अथवा जिस गुण में स्थित अपने कर्मों की हानि देखे, दूसरे की नहीं, उसमें न ठहरे।
english: Or, in whichever guṇa [one] stands [and] should see injury to one's own works, not the other's, in that [one] should not stand.
notes: 'na itarasya' = not [injury] of the other; the noun is understood. The first 'vā' rendered 'or'.

hindi: यह क्षय है।
english: This is decline.
notes: kṣaya = decline (glossary 9.7).

hindi: “मैं अधिक देर में, कम अथवा वृद्धि-उदय में अधिक क्षीण होऊँगा, दूसरा विपरीत,” जानकर क्षय की उपेक्षा करे।
english: “I shall decline after a longer time, less, or with a greater yield of growth; the other, the reverse,” knowing [this], [one] should disregard the decline.
notes: The adverbial words ciratareṇa, alpataram, vṛddhy-udayataram are elliptical; rendered literally. Alternative: 'I shall decline more slowly, by less, or with greater yield'.

words.gloss: having equal time, fruit and rise

hindi: अथवा समान काल, फल और उदय वाले क्षय में सन्धि अपनाए।
english: Or, in a decline having equal time, fruit and rise, [one] should resort to peace.

hindi: अथवा जिस गुण में स्थित अपने कर्मों की वृद्धि अथवा क्षय को न देखे, यह स्थान है।
english: Or, in whichever guṇa [one] stands [and] does not see growth or decline of one's own works, this is stagnation.

text_flags.why: etat is an inflected pronoun and a separate word, so the compound dot is probably a typo

notes: sthāna = stagnation (glossary 9.7). The unit is a conditional description, the main clause being the nominal 'this is stagnation'.

hindi: “मैं कम अथवा वृद्धि-उदय में अधिक स्थित रहूँगा, दूसरा विपरीत,” जानकर स्थान की उपेक्षा करे।
english: “I shall stay [for a] shorter [time] or with a greater yield of growth; the other, the reverse,” knowing [this], [one] should disregard stagnation.
notes: hrasvataram is elliptical (shorter / less); '[for a]' and '[time]' are supplied in English only. Hindi 'कम' keeps the ellipsis.

words.gloss: having equal time, fruit and rise

hindi: “अथवा समान काल, फल और उदय वाले स्थान में सन्धि अपनाए,” ऐसा आचार्य कहते हैं।
english: “Or, in a stagnation having equal time, fruit and rise, [one] should resort to peace,” say the teachers.
notes: Quoted view of the teachers (ācāryāḥ), with the following unit giving Kautilya's reply.

words.gram: n. nom. sg. past part. vi-√bhāṣ

hindi: “यह स्पष्ट रूप से कहा नहीं गया,” ऐसा कौटिल्य कहते हैं।
english: “This is not explained,” says Kautilya.
notes: vibhāṣita: literal 'expounded, stated distinctly'; Kautilya's rejection of the teachers' view may mean 'not properly stated' or 'not (one of the) optional'. Kept literal.

words.gloss: through abundance of fruit and gain
bringing the yoga of the other's works
I shall cause to flow in

words.gram: m. nom. sg. past part. vi-√grah

words.gloss: whose undertaking of works has failed
whose undertaking of works has started
in the desire for the circle
I shall cause to be taken

words.gram: m. acc. sg. past part. vi-√dviṣ

hindi:
अथवा यदि देखे, “सन्धि में स्थित होकर मैं महाफल वाले अपने कर्मों से दूसरे के कर्मों को हानि पहुँचाऊँगा; अथवा महाफल वाले अपने कर्मों का उपभोग करूँगा, दूसरे के कर्मों का अथवा; सन्धि के विश्वास से अथवा योग, उपनिषद् और प्रणिधियों से दूसरे के कर्मों को हानि पहुँचाऊँगा; अथवा सुखपूर्वक, अनुग्रह, परिहार और सुगमता से युक्त, दूसरे के कर्मों के योग को लाने वाले जन को अपने कर्मों के फल और लाभ की अधिकता से बहा लाऊँगा —
अथवा अत्यन्त बलवान् के साथ मिला हुआ दूसरा अपने कर्मों की हानि पाएगा; अथवा जिसके साथ, मुझसे विग्रह किया हुआ, वह सन्धि करता है, उसके साथ उसका विग्रह लम्बा करूँगा; अथवा मुझसे मिले हुए मेरे द्वेषी के जनपद को पीड़ित करेगा —
अथवा दूसरे से पीड़ित उसका जनपद मेरे पास आएगा, तब मैं कर्मों में वृद्धि पाऊँगा; अथवा विफल कर्मारम्भ वाला, विषम स्थिति में स्थित दूसरा कर्मों में मेरे विरुद्ध पराक्रम न करे —
दूसरे की ओर से जिसके कर्मों का आरम्भ हो चुका है, अथवा उन दोनों के साथ मिला हुआ मैं कर्मों में वृद्धि पाऊँगा; अथवा शत्रु से बँधे मण्डल को, शत्रु के साथ सन्धि करके, तोड़ूँगा —
टूटे हुए को पाऊँगा; अथवा सेना के अनुग्रह से शत्रु को सहारा देकर मण्डल पाने की इच्छा में विद्वेष ग्रहण कराऊँगा, विद्वेष किए गए को उसी से मरवाऊँगा,” सन्धि से वृद्धि का आश्रय ले।
english:
Or if [one] should see: “Standing in peace, with my own works of great fruit I shall injure the other's works; or I shall enjoy my own works of great fruit, or the other's works; or by trust in peace, or by contrivance, upaniṣad and agents, I shall injure the other's works; or easily, with favour, exemption and ease, through abundance of fruit and gain of my own works, I shall cause the people bringing the yoga of the other's works to flow in —
or the other, allied with an exceedingly strong [one], will obtain injury to his own works; or I shall make long the war of him with whom, attacked by me, he makes peace; or [he] will oppress the country of my hater, of the allied [one] —
or his country, injured by another, will come to me, then I shall obtain growth in works; or the other, whose undertaking of works has failed [and] who stands in difficulty, might not venture against me in works —
or I, whose undertaking of works has started from the other side, allied with those two, shall obtain growth in works; or, having made peace with the enemy, I shall break the circle bound by the enemy —
[and] shall obtain the broken one; or, having supported the enemy by favour of the army, in the desire for the circle I shall cause hatred to be taken; the hated one I shall have killed by that very one,” [one] should adopt growth by peace.

text_flags.why: mayā (instrumental) and sandhatte (verb) are separate words, so the compound dot is probably a typo
possible: 'allied with me' sits oddly beside 'my hater'; 'not allied with me' would suit the sense, but the printed reading may be original

notes: One quotation of five printed lines joined by '-' tokens (continuation marks of the e-text, not words); the editors' dashes at the end of lines 1-4 are rendered with a long dash in the translation. Many hard points: (1) āsrāvayiṣyāmi is from ā-√sru 'flow' (caus.), 'cause to flow in'; if from √śru it would be 'proclaim', not adopted; (2) para-karma-yoga-āvaha, yoga kept literal, sense unsettled (bringing/carrying out the other's works?); (3) sa-anugraha-parihāra-saukarya taken as adjective of janam (favour, exemption, ease); (4) yoga-upaniṣat-praṇidhi: yoga = secret contrivance, upaniṣad = secret device (kept), praṇidhi = agent; (5) mayā vā saṃhitasya mad-dveṣiṇaḥ is doubtful (see text_flags): as printed 'of the allied [one], my hater'; the subject of pīḍayiṣyati is not expressed; (6) sva-karma in line 2 read as the other's own works; (7) parataḥ 'from the other side' doubtful; (8) daṇḍa-anugraha: daṇḍa = army (prakṛti sense), 'favour of the army' = support with the army; (9) grāhayiṣyāmi: caus. √grah, literal 'cause hatred to be taken'; sense (make him take up hatred) not applied. The second vā in 'yena vā' etc. each rendered 'or'.

words.gloss: with protection of mountain, forest, river, fort and single entrance
at the end of the territory

words.gram: m. nom. sg. past part. apa-ā-√śri

words.gloss: whose energy is struck by calamity and affliction
for whom the time of injury to works has arrived

hindi:
अथवा यदि देखे, “मेरा जनपद अधिकतर आयुधीय या अधिकतर श्रेणी-सैन्य वाला, अथवा पर्वत, वन, नदी, दुर्ग और एक द्वार की रक्षा वाला, दूसरे के आक्रमण को रोकने में समर्थ होगा; अथवा देश के अन्त में असह्य दुर्ग का आश्रय लेकर मैं दूसरे के कर्मों को हानि पहुँचाने में समर्थ होऊँगा —
अथवा व्यसन और पीड़ा से आहत उत्साह वाला, जिसके कर्मों की हानि का समय आ गया है, दूसरा; अथवा विग्रह किए गए के अन्य ओर से मैं जनपद को हटा ले जाने में समर्थ होऊँगा,” विग्रह में स्थित वृद्धि का आश्रय ले।
english:
Or if [one] should see: “My country, mostly soldiers or mostly guild troops, or with the protection of mountain, forest, river, fort and a single entrance, will be able to repel the other's attack; or, having resorted to an insuperable fort at the end of the territory, I shall be able to injure the other's works —
or the other, his energy struck by calamity and affliction, [for whom] the time of injury to works has arrived; or, [the other] being attacked from elsewhere, I shall be able to carry away the country,” [one] standing in war should adopt growth.
notes: One quotation over two printed lines joined by a '-' token. (1) śreṇī-prāyaḥ: śreṇī = guild troops (glossary 10.1), medium; (2) śaila-vana-nadī-durga-eka-dvāra-ārakṣaḥ: ārakṣa = guard/protection; the sequence may also be read as 'protected by mountain, forest, river fort with a single door'; (3) aviṣahya = insuperable (glossary 3.15 'the unbearable'); (4) vigṛhītasya anyataḥ vā: literally 'of the one attacked, from elsewhere'; the person attacked and the sense of apavāhayitum (carry away) are not stated, so the possessor of the country is left open; (5) in line 2 the clause 'vyasana-pīḍa... kālaḥ' has no verb; no copula is supplied in Hindi, '[for whom]' is supplied in English.

words.gloss: of a dog and a boar
intent on carrying out my own works

hindi: अथवा यदि माने, “दूसरा मेरे कर्मों को हानि पहुँचाने में समर्थ नहीं है, अथवा मैं उसके कर्मों को हानि पहुँचाने वाला नहीं हूँ, उसका व्यसन है, अथवा कुत्ते और सूअर के समान कलह में, अथवा अपने कर्मों के अनुष्ठान में तत्पर मैं बढ़ूँगा,” आसन से वृद्धि का आश्रय ले।
english: Or if [one] should think: “The other is not able to injure my works, or I am not the injurer of his works; [there is] calamity of his, or [he is] in a quarrel like that of a dog and a boar, or I shall grow, intent on carrying out my own works,” [one] should adopt growth by staying quiet.
notes: The original is elliptical: 'na-ahaṃ tasya karma-upaghātī vā' read 'or I am not the injurer of his works'; 'vyasanam asya' has no verb. The two later vā-s each rendered 'or'. śva-varāhayoḥ iva kalahe: 'in a quarrel like that of a dog and a boar'.

words.gloss: with the protection of my own works arranged

hindi: अथवा यदि माने, “शत्रु के कर्मों की हानि यान से साध्य है और मैं अपने कर्मों की रक्षा की व्यवस्था किए हुए हूँ,” यान से वृद्धि का आश्रय ले।
english: Or if [one] should think: “The injury to the enemy's works is to be accomplished by march, and I am [one] with the protection of my own works arranged,” [one] should adopt growth by march.
notes: prativihita = arranged, provided for; 'I am [one]' supplied in brackets in English only.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. past part. ā-√śri

words.gloss: by carrying out one's own works

hindi: अथवा यदि माने, “मैं दूसरे के कर्मों को हानि पहुँचाने में समर्थ नहीं हूँ, अथवा अपने कर्मों की हानि से बचाने में,” बलवान् का आश्रय लेकर अपने कर्मों के अनुष्ठान से क्षय से स्थान की और स्थान से वृद्धि की आकांक्षा करे।
english: Or if [one] should think: “I am not able to injure the other's works, or to protect against injury to my own works,” having resorted to a strong one, by carrying out one's own works [one] should aspire to stagnation from decline, and to growth from stagnation.
notes: trātum: 'to protect (against)' – the construction with the accusative upaghātam is literal; alternative 'to ward off'. The iti is followed by a comma and carried by the quotation marks. ākāṅkṣeta: aspire to / wish for (the 3.4 glossary 'await' is a Book 3 sense).

hindi: अथवा यदि माने, “एक ओर सन्धि से अपने कर्मों को चलाऊँगा, एक ओर विग्रह से दूसरे के कर्मों को हानि पहुँचाऊँगा,” द्वैधीभाव से वृद्धि का आश्रय ले।
english: Or if [one] should think: “On one side, by peace, I shall set my own works in motion; on one side, by war, I shall injure the other's works,” [one] should adopt growth by the dual policy.
notes: ekataḥ = on one side (from one side).

words.gloss: in the circle of constituent elements

hindi: इस प्रकार इन छह गुणों से प्रकृति-मण्डल में स्थित कर्मों में क्षय से स्थान और स्थान से वृद्धि की खोज करे।
english: In this way, standing in the circle of constituent elements with these six guṇas, [one] should seek, in works, stagnation from decline and growth from stagnation.
notes: Closing verse (two half-verse lines). paryeṣeta: should seek out, aim at. The subject is not expressed.
